title: Design: Closed internal work order header shows the Closed on line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a closed internal work order, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow3-01-01-work-order-closed.png, iwo-happy-36-36-closed-work-order.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header card carries the line "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab." and no Reopen button.
  • Change Customer on the customer card is greyed out; hovering it shows "Reopen the work order to change the customer."

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S2-R9: “From Close or invoice on, the classification and the category are locked: a closed no-charge work order shows the No Charge badge with no Convert or Change category action, on a closed internal or no-charge work order the Change Customer button on the customer card is disabled with the tooltip "Reopen the work order to change the customer." (the lock an invoiced or paid billable work order has today, S2-R7), and the header card carries the line "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab."”
  • S4-R1: “On a closed internal or no-charge work order the Finance tab's invoice menu shows "Reopen Work Order" where a billable work order shows "Reverse", and no Issue Credit. It is the only place to reopen; the work order header carries the line of S2-R9 and no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 3 · Reopen" / "Happy flow v6", boards "01 Work order · Closed" (Flow 3 · Reopen), "36 Closed work order" (Happy flow v6).
